name: NullSec Security Headers — Cloudflare Transform Rules
description: Import via CF Dashboard > Rules > Transform Rules > Modify Response Headers

headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=(), microphone=(self), fullscreen=(self)

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' wss:; media-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; upgrade-insecure-requests

notes.audit: hackercord-audit.md — Finding C1 (No Security Headers) + M1 (Server Header Leak)
notes.effort: 1 hour (just import these rules in CF dashboard)
